method: GET-only authenticated Apify API v2 Actor and run readback

claim_boundary.runs: Run activity includes owner canaries, schedules, tasks, and possible external use; the API rows do not prove buyer identity or country.
claim_boundary.non_owner_public_runs_30_days: Apify defines publicActorRunStats30Days as public-Actor runs in the last 30 days excluding runs started by the Actor owner. These are external Store-use events, not proof of payment or distinct customers.
claim_boundary.users: Actor-level user counts can overlap across Actors and are relationships, not a portfolio-wide unique-person count.
claim_boundary.countries: No run-country attribution is available from this readback.
claim_boundary.revenue: Usage cost is platform consumption, not creator revenue. Revenue remains unproven without profit, payout, invoice, or payment readback.
